source.quote: Ferrum's own page for the WANDLA HP « DAC/PREAMP with Headphone AMPLIFIER », read 2026-11-27 with curl. Digital inputs: « USB-C (up to 768 kHz / 32 bit, DSD 512, DoP 256) »; « I2S (up to 768 kHz / 32bit, DSD 512, DoP 256), User-selectable I²S pinout via firmware, compatible with PS Audio and other I²S standards. »; « ARC (up to 192 kHz / 24 bit), TV input with CEC »; « AES/EBU (up to 192 kHz / 24 bit, DoP 64) »; « Coaxial S/PDIF (up to 192 kHz / 24 bit, DoP 64) »; « Optical S/PDIF (up to 96 kHz / 24 bit) ». « DAC chip: ESS Sabre ES9038PRO »; « DAC resolution: 768 kHz / 32 bit, DSD 512 »; « MQA: decoder and renderer (on all digital inputs) ».

facts.chip: ESS ES9038PRO with Ferrum's in-house I/V converter (« The ESS Sabre ES9038PRO combined with Ferrum's advanced new current-to-voltage (I/V) converter »).

_optical_rated_flat_96_here: Unlike the WANDLA and ERCO pages, this one gives optical a flat « up to 96 kHz / 24 bit » with no « should work » clause and no DoP. Recorded as stated.
_ARC_is_hdmi: ARC from a television, recorded as hdmi as on ferrum/wandla.
